Without a key, an `{#each}` block updates its items by position. When an item is removed or moved, the items after it keep the state of the ones that were there before. An `{#each}` without an item (`{#each { length: 3 }}`) needs no key.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { "svelte/require-each-key": "error" } },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}

```svelte
{#each todos as todo}
  <TodoItem {todo} />
{/each}
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}

```svelte
{#each todos as todo (todo.id)}
  <TodoItem {todo} />
{/each}
```
